exposure: preterm prelabor rupture of the fetal membranes (PPROM)
outcome: expression of mRNA coding for proinflammatory genes (IL1B, CD14, NFKB1, TNFRSF1A) in maternal blood
cohort: Women recruited with preterm prelabor rupture of the fetal membranes (PPROM) at a mean gestational age of 28.9 weeks, with and without chorioamnionitis at delivery, alongside gestation-matched healthy controls.
finding: Circulating proinflammatory mRNA, specifically IL1B, CD14, NFKB1, and TNFRSF1A, were significantly increased in the maternal blood of women with PPROM who developed chorioamnionitis compared to those without chorioamnionitis or healthy controls.
